subject: Culture
title: Diwali's Many Origins
description: A fast breakdown of Diwali's Many Origins for builders.

hook.text: Diwali isn't one festival. Hindus, Jains, Sikhs, and some Buddhists each celebrate for different reasons.

buildup.text: Hindus mark Rama's return from exile. Jains honor Mahavira's liberation. Sikhs celebrate Hargobind's release.

discovery.text: The name comes from 'Deepavali'—row of lights. Lamps symbolize knowledge conquering ignorance.

twist.text: Diwali now rivals Christmas in global commerce. India's consumer spending spikes higher than any other holiday.

climax.text: Multiple religions share one festival but tell completely different stories about why they celebrate.

punchline.text: Same lights, different stories behind them.
